verdict.rationale: RudderStack explicitly offers self-hosted/on-prem deployment and region-specific processing: 'Store data on your own infrastructure, not ours. Multi-region businesses can process data in the US, EU, or both individually,' backed by an open-source self-hosted architecture. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of actual multi-region setup, no detail on which managed-cloud regions are offered or how residency is configured/enforced in practice.
